ticket_priorities.label: Low
ticket_priorities.hint: Scheduled in normal order — good for preventative or low-impact jobs.

ticket_priorities.label: Medium
ticket_priorities.hint: Typical urgency — supervisors route in standard queue sequence.

ticket_priorities.label: High
ticket_priorities.hint: Supervisors should prioritise assignment and milestone follow-up.

ticket_priorities.label: Critical
ticket_priorities.hint: Urgent safety or severe service impact — treat as immediate attention.

ticket_title_templates.title: AC Unit Not Cooling — Inspection Required
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
AC unit reported not cooling to the required temperature.

Scope of work:
- Inspect FCU filters and coils
- Check refrigerant levels and pressure
- Verify thermostat and controls operation
- Clean/service unit as required
- Document findings and corrective action taken

ticket_title_templates.title: AC Water Leak — Emergency Repair
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Water leakage reported from AC unit.

Scope of work:
- Locate and identify source of water leak
- Clear condensate drain line blockage
- Check drain pan and insulation condition
- Repair or replace faulty components
- Test operation after repair

ticket_title_templates.title: Chiller Fault — Immediate Attention
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Central chiller unit reported faulty.

Scope of work:
- Run diagnostic check on chiller controls
- Inspect compressor, condenser, and evaporator
- Check refrigerant levels and pressures
- Log all fault codes and alarms
- Carry out corrective maintenance or escalate if major fault

ticket_title_templates.title: HVAC Scheduled Preventive Maintenance
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Routine preventive maintenance for HVAC system.

Scope of work:
- Clean and replace air filters
- Check belt tensions and motor performance
- Lubricate all moving parts
- Inspect controls, sensors, and thermostats
- Verify air flow and temperature set points
- Update maintenance log

ticket_title_templates.title: Ductwork Noise / Vibration Issue
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Excessive noise or vibration reported from ductwork.

Scope of work:
- Inspect duct connections and supports
- Check for loose panels or damper issues
- Balance airflow if required
- Apply vibration dampening where needed

ticket_title_templates.title: Power Outage — Area Affected
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Power outage reported in the specified area.

Scope of work:
- Identify tripped breakers or blown fuses
- Inspect distribution board for faults
- Check for short circuits or overloads
- Restore power safely and test all circuits
- Document root cause and preventive measures

ticket_title_templates.title: Lighting Fixture Fault — Replacement
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Lighting fixture reported faulty or not working.

Scope of work:
- Identify faulty fixture(s)
- Replace lamp/bulb or entire fitting as required
- Check wiring connections and earthing
- Test operation after replacement

ticket_title_templates.title: Electrical Panel Inspection
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Routine inspection of electrical distribution panel.

Scope of work:
- Visual inspection of all MCBs and connections
- Check for signs of overheating, corrosion, or damage
- Tighten all cable terminations
- Test RCDs and safety devices
- Update inspection record

ticket_title_templates.title: Generator Startup / Test Run
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Scheduled generator test run and inspection.

Scope of work:
- Start generator and run under load for 30 minutes
- Check fuel level, oil level, and coolant
- Inspect battery and charging system
- Record running hours and performance readings
- Resolve any faults observed during test

ticket_title_templates.title: Water Leak — Urgent Repair
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Water leak reported. Urgent action required.

Scope of work:
- Isolate water supply to affected area
- Identify and locate leak source
- Repair or replace faulty pipe / fitting
- Test for leaks after repair
- Inspect surrounding area for water damage

ticket_title_templates.title: Blocked Drain / Sewage Backup
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Drain blockage or sewage backup reported.

Scope of work:
- Identify blocked drain location
- Use appropriate clearing method (plunger, snake, CCTV if needed)
- Clear blockage and flush drain
- Inspect for root cause (grease, debris, structural issue)
- Advise occupant on prevention

ticket_title_templates.title: Low Water Pressure Complaint
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Low water pressure reported in the specified unit/area.

Scope of work:
- Check pressure at incoming supply
- Inspect and clean pressure regulator valve
- Check for partial blockages in pipework
- Inspect pump performance if applicable
- Document readings and corrective action

ticket_title_templates.title: Sanitary Fixture Replacement
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Sanitary fixture repair or replacement required.

Scope of work:
- Remove existing faulty fixture
- Install new fixture and connect to supply and waste
- Test for leaks and proper operation
- Seal and finish to required standard

ticket_title_templates.title: Wall / Ceiling Crack — Assessment
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Crack reported in wall or ceiling. Assessment required.

Scope of work:
- Inspect crack dimensions and pattern
- Determine if structural or non-structural
- Mark crack for monitoring if minor
- Carry out repair: fill, grout, plaster, and paint finish
- Escalate to structural engineer if major concern

ticket_title_templates.title: Floor Tile Damage — Repair
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Damaged or loose floor tiles reported.

Scope of work:
- Remove damaged tiles carefully
- Prepare substrate surface
- Install replacement tiles with appropriate adhesive
- Grout and seal joints
- Match finish to existing floor as closely as possible

ticket_title_templates.title: Door / Window Not Closing Properly
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Door or window reported not closing, sticking, or damaged.

Scope of work:
- Inspect hinges, frame alignment, and hardware
- Adjust or replace hinges/closers as required
- Re-align door/window frame if needed
- Repair or replace lock mechanisms
- Test operation after repair

ticket_title_templates.title: Painting & Touch-Up Works
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Painting or touch-up work required.

Scope of work:
- Prepare surface (clean, sand, fill cracks)
- Apply primer coat where needed
- Apply finish paint to match existing
- Protect surrounding areas during work
- Inspect and touch up after drying

ticket_title_templates.title: Deep Clean Required — Post-Construction
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Post-construction deep clean required for the specified area.

Scope of work:
- Remove all construction debris and waste
- Deep clean all floors, walls, and surfaces
- Clean all fixtures, fittings, and glass
- Clean and sanitise wet areas
- Final inspection and sign-off

ticket_title_templates.title: Pest Control — Urgent Treatment
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Pest infestation reported. Urgent treatment required.

Scope of work:
- Identify pest type and infestation extent
- Apply appropriate treatment (gel, spray, fumigation)
- Seal entry points where identified
- Leave monitoring bait stations if required
- Provide follow-up schedule

ticket_title_templates.title: Routine Cleaning Not Done — Complaint
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Complaint received: routine cleaning service not carried out as scheduled.

Scope of work:
- Carry out missed cleaning service immediately
- Verify cleaning schedule compliance
- Document reason for missed service
- Implement corrective measure to prevent recurrence

ticket_title_templates.title: General Maintenance Request
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
General maintenance work order.

Scope of work:
- Inspect and assess reported issue
- Carry out required maintenance or repair
- Source materials if needed
- Test and verify completion
- Document work performed and materials used

ticket_title_templates.title: Urgent Emergency — Immediate Response Required
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
URGENT: Emergency maintenance required. Immediate response needed.

Scope of work:
- Respond immediately to site
- Assess situation and take immediate corrective action
- Make area safe and isolate hazard if required
- Carry out permanent repair or temporary fix
- Report findings and recommend follow-up works

ticket_title_templates.title: Scheduled Preventive Maintenance Visit
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Scheduled preventive maintenance visit as per PPM plan.

Scope of work:
- Carry out all items listed on the PPM checklist
- Inspect equipment and systems for signs of wear
- Lubricate, clean, and adjust as required
- Record readings and observations
- Report any defects found for corrective action

ticket_title_templates.title: Site Inspection & Condition Report
ticket_title_templates.description_template:
Site inspection visit to assess overall condition.

Scope of work:
- Walk through assigned areas and inspect all systems
- Photograph any defects or areas of concern
- Record condition ratings for each area
- Prepare and submit condition report
- Prioritise findings for action
